units: <cite ref="Sotah 19b:4">Sot. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>שרִישּׁוּמוֹ ניכר</he> when the traces of the writing are noticeable (not entirely washed off the paper); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9<sup>23</sup></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 25a:23">Ber. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>רִשּׁוּמָן ניכר</he> their marks (stains) are seen on the floor; Y. ib. III, 6ᵈ bot.; a. fr.
